terms: Demo: price per 1,000 calls to a market-data API, 30-day term, in US cents
disclosure: Demo only: mandates, offers, stances and salts are published so every on-chain hash can be recomputed. A real agent never discloses them.

separation.note: Three OS processes on one machine. Each agent process loaded only its own key and limit; the relay process never read the agents' keys and reached them over HTTP on 127.0.0.1.

buyer.explanation: Opened at 3650, 350 below the reference, 650 below its limit.
buyer.note: Plan: R1 open 3650 (350 below ref 4000) to anchor low while keeping 650 of room. R2 if no cross, step to ~3900-3950 (still under reference, signals movement). R3 if still no cross, step to ~4150-4200 — high enough to likely cross a seller anchored near/above reference, but deliberately short of the 4300 limit so the limit is never revealed publicly. Never submit 4300 itself. Seller rep 4.38/6 reviews (3 trusted) = reasonably trustworthy, so expect a serious but firm counter; assume crossing happ

seller.explanation: Opened at 4800, 800 above the reference, 700 above its limit.
seller.note: Plan: R1 anchor 4800 (+800 over reference) to leave concession room above my 4100 floor. R2: if no cross, step down to ~4450 (still +450 over ref, keeps 350 of buffer). R3: final at ~4200 — above the limit so a cross still clears above 4100, and deliberately NOT at 4100 so the buyer never learns my exact floor. Any cross settles at the midpoint at or above my ask, so a high anchor is cheap insurance; the real risk is no deal, so I will concede steadily if rounds burn. Buyer rep: 4.70 avg over 6
